basis: Trichomonas infection predominantly affects genital mucosa; urinary tract disease is subtype-specific rather than established across the group.
Lysosomal storage disease causing progressive neurodegeneration; retinal degeneration with visual loss occurs in most patients.
Hereditary glomerular disease; hearing impairment, lenticonus and retinal hemorrhage each occur in 30-79%; non-damaging retinal flecks alone would not qualify.
Inherited loss of subcutaneous adipose tissue with metabolic dysfunction; additional organ damage varies substantially across subtypes.
Benign vascular neoplasm; no specific additional organ of origin or damage is established.
Arylsulfatase deficiency causing skeletal dysplasia; mixed hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%; airway and spinal cord complications occur in 5-29%.
Mandibular aplasia, brain malformations and otocephaly define syndrome; severe ocular malformations occur in 80-99%; airway and oral defects omitted by cap.
Malignancy of hematopoietic cells occupying marrow and blood; additional organ infiltration is not consistently common across leukemia subtypes.
Clinical mucositis predominantly concerns oral and alimentary mucosal injury; respiratory and reproductive mucosal sites are subtype-specific.
Defined as inherited metabolic disease causing abnormal development or destruction of central white matter, often also affecting peripheral nerves.
Neuro-ocular-renal syndrome; intestinal malrotation occurs in 2/3 reported patients; pituitary deficits in 1/1 and skeletal anomalies omitted by cap.
Cirrhosis and muscle weakness 2/2; spasticity 2/2 with CNS injury/neuropathy 1/2; cardiac, renal and pancreatic involvement (1/2 each) omitted by cap.
Retinal degeneration with retinal detachment directly affects the eye.
Iron accumulation disorder; affected organs vary across subtypes, and iron deposition alone does not establish functional organ damage.
Skeletal disease and corneal opacity approach 100%; mitral regurgitation 27/28; airway, skin, splenic and hearing involvement omitted by cap.
Intellectual disability and pigmentary mosaicism define syndrome; amblyopia/myopic astigmatism reported in 1/2; gallstones are separate disease; otitis lacks proven lasting damage.
Premature fusion of one coronal suture; associated amblyopia, strabismus and astigmatism each occur in 30-79%, reflecting impaired visual function.
ARL6-related rod-cone retinal degeneration; this concept specifies retinitis pigmentosa rather than a multisystem ciliopathy.
Inherited persistent developmental speech-fluency disorder affecting neurologic speech control.
Isolated sperm motility failure causing male infertility; reproductive function is outside the axes, with no endocrine disorder established.
Definition specifies an immune-mediated neutrophilic dermatosis; any associated systemic illness is a separate condition.
Parathyroid hormone excess commonly causes chronic high-turnover bone loss (>30%); renal disease is an underlying cause rather than damage caused by this condition.
Epiphyseal osteochondral overgrowth directly causes skeletal deformity, joint stiffness and degeneration.
Methionine-cycle defect defined by myopathy and developmental impairment; liver abnormalities 30-79%, elevated transaminases 80-99%; coagulation and ocular findings omitted by cap.
Nephrotic kidney failure and neurodevelopmental impairment occur in 3/3; scoliosis in 1/3 (~33%) supports skeletal involvement, with uncertainty from the small series.
